title: The VC-dimension of strongly regular graphs
summary: A graph $G$ is $n$-existentially closed or $n$-e.c. if, for all subsets $S\subseteq V(G)$ with $|S|=n$ and for all partitions $S=A\sqcup B$, there exists a vertex in $V(G)\setminus S$ adjacent to all vertices in $A$ and no vertices in $B$. We study the minimum number of edges $m(v,n)$ of a $v$-vertex $n$-e.c. graph, and show that $m(v,2)=3v+O(1)$ while $m(v,n)=Θ(v\log v)$ for fixed $n\ge 3$. The latter result uses a connection to binary covering arrays.
